root_cause: After the alias fix (#5103) the Portal V2 Live Preview runs kept ending red. Auto-merge closes a PR within minutes; the workflow_run then starts after the merge, the numbered PR alias no longer serves the PR head, release.json never shows the head SHA, and the wait loop fails after 9 minutes with 'Timed out waiting for immutable Netlify preview'. The alias branch itself ran correctly.

observed_evidence.source: GitHub Actions runs of portal-v2-live-preview.yml after merge 148a73d, PR states and job logs
observed_evidence.example_pr: #5135 closed 5 seconds after its run started

fix: The wait step reads the PR state every round. A closed or merged PR writes a notice, sets PREVIEW_PR_CLOSED=1 and exits 0; every later step except the evidence upload is skipped. An open PR keeps the full wait and still fails on a real provider failure or timeout. No new token permission.
prevention_rule: A check that waits on a per-PR resource must first confirm that the PR is still open. A green or red result is only meaningful for an open PR. After a fix, prove it on a PR that stays open before closing the fingerprint.

invariants: a closed or merged PR never ends the preview run red
an open PR still fails on provider failure or timeout
no actions: write permission is added
all later steps are skipped for a closed PR
